description: Land Title Settlement Department - Horethuduwa, D/S Division, Panadura, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530011 and Other Notices
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel No. 34 and 119) with detailed ownership information, property descriptions, and legal status. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
